subject.title: docs(install): add vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide

question: Should OpenClaw core docs accept a vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide after the NVIDIA setup guidance is repaired, and should turnkey vendor hardware references be omitted from that guide?
rationale: The code/docs defect is mechanically repairable, but the linked issue explicitly asks for first-party docs scope and vendor-reference policy that repository automation cannot decide.

options.title: Accept Vendor-Neutral Guide After Repair
options.body: Allow the Jetson install page once NVIDIA-backed setup details are accurate and commercial turnkey references stay out of core docs.

options.title: Keep Jetson Docs Outside Core
options.body: Close or pause this PR and route Jetson-specific setup to vendor/community docs if maintainers do not want first-party hardware install pages beyond the existing Pi precedent.

options.title: Accept With Explicit Hardware Policy
options.body: Require a short documented policy for first-party hardware guides and turnkey references before this page lands.

recommendation.title: Accept Vendor-Neutral Guide After Repair
recommendation.body: Allow the Jetson install page once NVIDIA-backed setup details are accurate and commercial turnkey references stay out of core docs.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is tied to current docs policy, VISION scope, and adjacent docs maintenance in the inspected history.
